item.title: Emerging Threats
item.description: A new vulnerability usually reaches advisory databases days after it is disclosed, so scanners that read those databases can’t report it yet. DefectDojo builds an Early Light detector for the most urgent ones, often within a day of disclosure. Emerging Threats shows you that work: which threats DefectDojo is building detectors for, which detectors are ready, how to run them, and what they found in your instance.
